card.name: Inside tables and percentages in labels
card.fires_on: Pieces inside table-like text in drug labels, such as the digit in a percentage, table filler dashes, or table headings like n/N. It also fires on a few mid-name pieces such as difficile.

modes.label: Digits in percentages
modes.description: A digit inside a percentage or count in a results table, often before the % sign.

modes.label: Table filler and headings
modes.description: Dashes, n/N and similar cell content in flattened tables.

modes.label: Legend or name pieces
modes.description: A word completing a legend entry or organism name inside a table or sentence.

card.writes: It slightly favors line breaks, periods and bold markers, and disfavors heading markers, so it adds little beyond structure.
card.plain: It marks numbers and cells inside the flattened tables of drug labels, especially percentages.
